quarterly_data.signal: Audit status: on September 30, 2026 Nidec received from PricewaterhouseCoopers Japan LLC an audit report with a disclaimer of opinion on the consolidated and non-consolidated financial statements in its securities report for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, a disclaimer of review conclusion on the Q3 (October-December 2025) quarterly statements, and an internal control audit report with a disclaimer of opinion (the company states it could not express the results of its assessment of internal control over financial reporting). The auditor's basis, as reproduced by Nidec, cites officers and employees involved in the improper accounting who still hold financial-reporting roles, and the impairment losses of JPY 632,221 million; it also notes the company identified falsified testing and inspection records and unauthorized use of non-conforming materials at multiple production bases, and underpaid tariffs on import transactions of USD 94.1 million (approximately JPY 14,160 million) including interest. Nidec says it takes the disclaimers seriously and will take appropriate actions.
